FACT_ID: sec15-R01 | anchor: A01
Every merge counts as an intersection, while three ordered looks work each one [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crossings; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec15-F02 and sec15-F03.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec15-R02 | anchor: A01
Triple looks assume no courtesy, while lit blinkers earn no trust until cars swing [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint crossings; prereq_hint sec15-F03; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec15-F03 and sec15-F04.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec15-R03 | anchor: A02
Wide rural crossings split at medians in two gap judgments, while fast traffic and long rigs punish rushing [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint rural-cross; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec15-F05 and sec15-F06.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec15-R04 | anchor: A02
Ramp entrants scan, accelerate, and merge unstopped, while incumbents slide to admit them [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint onramp; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec15-F07.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec15-R05 | anchor: A03
Reduced-conflict lefts become rights plus U-turns, while one-direction focus drops the double-gap wait [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint interchanges; prereq_hint sec15-F05; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec15-F08.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec15-R06 | anchor: A04
Diamonds detour briefly wrong-sided, while shorter signals pay for the strangeness [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint interchanges; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec15-F09.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec15-R07 | anchor: A05
Rings yield rather than stop at calming speeds, while entries yield to circle traffic and crosswalks [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint roundabout; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec15-F10 and sec15-F11.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec15-R08 | anchor: A05
Single-lane rings ride through to signaled right exits, while walkers island-hop and riders walk or center up [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint roundabout; prereq_hint sec15-F11; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec15-F12 and sec15-F13.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec15-R09 | anchor: A05
Multi-lane rings pre-pick lanes and signal late rights, while swaps, truck shadows, and outside overruns stay banned [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint roundabout; prereq_hint sec15-F11; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec15-F15 and sec15-F16.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec15-R10 | anchor: A06
Gravel steals grip and sight together, while gentle inputs and mapped blind spots answer [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint gravel; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec15-F18 and sec15-F19.
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ia-c:iowa-department-of-transportation-iowa-d:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec15-R11 | anchor: A06

Why it matters: group_hint gravel; prereq_hint sec15-F20; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec15-F20 and sec15-F21.
